_: « Le monde de Krizaka : le relais » — v2 of the reference film (orazaka#289; Oussama's brief of 2026-10-20). A soft dawn, then a relay across places and cultures (Morocco, Mile End, the Alps of Grenoble, Québec, California) where the flock meets, argues, helps and hands off one glowing parcel; the score switches genre with each place. Each bird's role is shown by what it does, never by a lineup. `references` logs how every cultural nod is evoked by original means; `legal.never` lists the names the film never says or shows.
title: The World of Krizaka: The Relay
logline: One glowing parcel, passed wing to wing across the world: the falcon seals it, the owl argues and lets it through, the duck rebuilds its strap, the falcon catches it in the Alps, a Québec family saves the frozen pigeon, the flamingo pays its share in California, and at the beach the parcel opens and the phoenix returns.
theme: A promise travels further when it is passed from wing to wing.
style: Premium feature-film CG animation, real-world light and lenses, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flares, filmic contrast, fine grain.
keep: One single continuous shot. The characters keep their exact cartoon design, proportions, colours and features, rendered as high-end feature-film CG characters with soft fine feather texture. Plain unbranded surfaces, no lettering.
keyframeKeep: Keep every character's exact shape, proportions, colours, eyes and features unchanged, as stylised cartoon characters rendered in high-end feature-film CG with soft fine feather texture, subsurface light and contact shadows. No text, no logos, no people.

Tilt up following the pigeon, 24 mm. Golden sky. Hopeful lift.

shots.motion: On a palm-lined coastal highway at golden hour, a candy-pink lowrider convertible bounces on its hydraulics; the pink flamingo character with a long curved neck, leaning against the car, turns with a smile as the sky-blue pigeon character lands on the hood, looks it in the eye and flicks it a gold coin that spins through the air, the pigeon grinning as it catches it in its wing. Low angle, 35 mm. Golden hour, lens flare. Cool, funny.

shots.purpose: Night falls on a neon city: the party is close.
shots.action: the view swings fast over the neon city at night between palm silhouettes and dives toward the beach, where rows of string lights switch on one by one around a sand dance floor
shots.plate: A neon-lit city at night seen from a rooftop, palm tree silhouettes, purple and cyan glow, distant hills with lights, no logos, no signs with letters, no text.
shots.keyframe: A neon-lit city at night seen from a rooftop, palm tree silhouettes, purple and cyan glow, distant hills with lights, no logos, no signs with letters, no text.
shots.motion: The view swings fast over the neon city at night between palm silhouettes and dives toward the beach, where rows of string lights switch on one by one around a sand dance floor. Fast drone swing, 24 mm. Purple and cyan neon.

shots.purpose: A friendly rivalry: two of the flock face off in a dance battle on the beach, the crowd of birds hyping them.
shots.intent: each wants to win the crowd, all in fun
shots.gaze: they stare each other down, then grin
shots.physics: the magpie spins and freezes, the flamingo answers with a long-legged slide, sand flying
shots.action: on the beach dance floor the magpie spins and freezes in a pose, then the flamingo answers with a long-legged slide, sand flying, and they point at each other grinning
shots.plate: A beach at night with a sand dance floor ringed by string lights and torches, purple and cyan party lights, palm trees, the ocean behind, no people, no text.
shots.keyframe: The magpie character and the flamingo character facing off in a dance battle on a lit beach dance floor at night, string lights and palm trees.
shots.motion: On a beach dance floor at night ringed by string lights, the slate-grey magpie character with cobalt-blue wings spins and freezes in a pose, staring the flamingo down; the pink flamingo character answers with a long-legged slide, sand flying, and they point at each other, then burst out laughing. Quick handheld orbit, 28 mm. Purple and cyan party lights. Energetic, fun.

shots.purpose: The DJ moment: the crane, who listens to everything, drops the beat; the duck builds the light show.
shots.intent: the crane gives the party its sound
shots.gaze: eyes closed, listening, then a sharp look to the crowd
shots.physics: the crane bobs its long neck to the beat, lifts a wing and drops it; the duck taps glowing blocks that pulse with the beat
shots.action: the crane at the decks bobs its long neck with its eyes closed, lifts a wing and drops the beat, and the duck beside it taps glowing blocks that pulse in time
shots.plate: A DJ booth on a beach at night, two turntables and a mixer on a wooden table, glowing cyan blocks stacked beside, purple and cyan lights, palm trees, no logos, no text.
shots.keyframe: The crane character at a DJ booth on a beach at night with turntables, the duck character beside it with glowing cyan blocks, purple and cyan lights.
shots.motion: At a beach DJ booth at night, the slender pale grey crane character with a small red crown bobs its long neck to the beat with its eyes closed, opens them, nods to the duck, lifts one wing and drops it as the lights flash; the crimson duck character with round glasses beside it taps glowing cyan blocks that pulse in time. Push-in, 35 mm. Purple and cyan lights, flashes. Euphoric.

shots.purpose: Promise 5 kept: the pigeon sets the parcel down in the middle of the flock; it opens into light and everyone cheers.
shots.intent: the pigeon delivers to the whole flock
shots.gaze: all eyes on the parcel as it opens
shots.physics: the pigeon sets the parcel down gently, steps back; light bursts out, the flock jumps and cheers, wings up
shots.interaction: the whole flock celebrates together around the parcel
shots.action: the pigeon sets the parcel down in the middle of the dance floor and steps back; it opens into a burst of warm light and the falcon, the owl, the duck and the flamingo jump and cheer, wings up
shots.plate: A beach dance floor at night ringed by string lights, purple and cyan party lights, palm trees, the ocean behind, no people, no text.
shots.keyframe: Five cartoon bird characters around a small glowing orange parcel on a beach dance floor at night, string lights, palm trees.
shots.motion: On the beach dance floor at night, the sky-blue pigeon character sets its small glowing orange parcel down in the middle of the flock and steps back; the parcel opens into a burst of warm golden light and the orange falcon, the violet owl, the crimson duck and the pink flamingo characters jump and cheer, wings up, turning to hug and high-five each other. Slow push-in then a quick crane up, 28 mm. Golden burst against purple night. Joyful.

shots.purpose: The return: from the parcel's light the phoenix rises over the ocean; the pigeon watches, proud.
shots.intent: the phoenix comes back to the flock
shots.gaze: the pigeon looks up at the phoenix
shots.physics: the phoenix's two flame wings unfold slowly as it rises, embers drifting down; the pigeon's feathers ruffle in the warm air
shots.interaction: the pigeon and the phoenix: a look between the one who carried and the one who returns
shots.action: the phoenix rises slowly from the light over the ocean, its violet and gold flame wings unfolding, and the pigeon in the foreground looks up, chest puffed with pride
shots.plate: A night beach with the dark ocean and a horizon glow, warm embers in the air, string lights blurred in the foreground sand, no people, no text.
shots.keyframe: The phoenix with one violet and one gold flame wing rising over the night ocean, the pigeon character seen from behind in the foreground on the sand looking up.
shots.motion: Over the night ocean, the phoenix with one violet flame wing and one gold flame wing beats its two great flame wings slowly up and down three times and rises higher into the sky, its flames flickering and trailing sparks, embers swirling down around it; in the foreground the sky-blue pigeon character looks up, raises one wing to wave at it, its feathers ruffling in the warm air, chest puffed with pride. Slow crane up, 24 mm. Warm gold against deep blue. Majestic, tender.
